description:
FILED s1061 (Opus, 2026-09-07) from #1061's CPAN-board bisects.  A named,
board-costed instance of the DEFERRED "Live symbol-table hashes" entry in
docs/not-supported.md.

THE DIVERGENCE, probed vs perl 5.40.3 (four one-liners, all four differ):

    sub names { no strict 'refs'; join(",", sort grep !/::\z/, keys %{"$_[0]::"}) }
    @{"Alpha::ISA"}   = ("Base");    names("Alpha")   perl [ISA]      PCL []
    ${"Beta::VERSION"} = 1;          names("Beta")    perl [VERSION]  PCL []
    %{"Gamma::H"}     = (a => 1);    names("Gamma")   perl [H]        PCL []
    *{"Delta::f"}     = sub { 1 };   names("Delta")   perl [f]        PCL [f]

`pcl::p-stash` builds its snapshot with `(do-symbols …)` and keeps only
`PL-xxx` symbols that have a function body, so a package holding ONLY
variables reads as empty.  Same answer through the glob spelling Role::Tiny
uses (`@{*{_getglob("Eps::ISA")}} = ("Base")`): PCL [] where perl says [ISA].

WHERE IT COSTS ROWS.  Role-Tiny t/role-long-package-name.t, PASS 7/0 at the
s378 board snapshot, FAIL 0/0 now.  Role::Tiny::_load_module is

    return 1 if grep !/::\z/, keys %{_getstash($module)};
    require $file;

and _build_class_with_roles gives a composed class only `@ISA`
(`@{*{_getglob("${new_name}::ISA")}} = ($superclass)`) when the roles are
empty, which they are in this file.  So PCL sees an empty stash and tries to
`require Foo__WITH__R/AAAA…__WITH__R/BBBB….pm` -- "Can't locate ... in @INC",
whole file lost.  perl sees the `ISA` key and returns 1.

WHY IT ONLY APPEARED NOW -- bisected to `e79f0a63` (s407a, Fable review fixes,
"a raw code ref numifies to its address", #362).  Role::Tiny::_install_does
line 477 is

    return if $to->can('DOES') and $to->can('DOES') != (UNIVERSAL->can('DOES') || 0);

-- a NUMERIC comparison of two code refs.  While every code ref numified the
same, that test was false, `_install_does` fell through and installed `does`
and `DOES` into every composed class, which put SUB entries in the stash and
made `_load_module` answer 1 by accident.  #362 made the numification correct,
the early return fires from the second composition onwards, and the composed
class is left with only `@ISA`.  A correct fix unmasking a deferred one:
"pre-existing is WHEN, not WHY" applies to the DEFERRAL, not to #362.

THE FIX is the roadmap item already written down in docs/not-supported.md
("Live symbol-table hashes (%main::, %Foo::) [DEFERRED]"): make p-stash list
the package's variable slots too, or make it a live proxy.  The cheap half --
adding a key for every `$`/`@`/`%` symbol the CL package holds -- is enough
for this row and for the `grep exists &{...}` consumers (Role::Tiny's own
_all_subs filters non-subs, so extra keys are safe there); the fiddly
remainder is real typeglob slots.  Measure the board and the sweep before and
after: `keys %{"Pkg::"}` is a counted thing in test files.
subject: A package stash (`%{"Pkg::"}`) lists only SUBS, so a class whose only symbol is `@ISA` looks EMPTY: Role::Tiny's `_load_module` then tries to `require` a composed class and dies (Role-Tiny role-long-package-name.t, PASS 7/0 -> FAIL 0/0, unmasked by #362)
